items.title: Duryodhana in Heaven, Pandavas in Hell? | MB 00 | Mahabharata in English
items.description:
Duryodhana sits on a golden throne in heaven… while the Pandavas and Draupadi cry out from a dark hell? 😳

The Kurukshetra war is long over. Dharmaraja Yudhishthira finally reaches heaven, and there, on a golden seat, sits his enemy Duryodhana. Where are his brothers and Draupadi? Hearing their cries in the darkness of hell, Dharmaraja chooses to leave heaven and stay with his own people. That was his final test.

Then the real beginning: how did Vyasa compose such a huge story? How did Ganesha write it without stopping? How did it travel to us through King Parikshit's curse and Janamejaya's snake sacrifice? Our Mahabharata series starts right here.

1:13 The road to hell
2:27 Indra's illusion – Dharmaraja's test

items.title: Why Did a Mother Give Her Seven Babies to the River? | MB 01 | Mahabharata in English
items.description:
A mother lets her seven newborn babies go into the river Ganga, one by one… and her husband watches and cannot say a single word. Why? 😳

A mysterious woman who sits on King Pratipa's thigh, her one condition, Shantanu bound by that condition, seven silences… and the promise that breaks at the eighth child. Who was she? The theft of sage Vasishtha's cow Nandini, the curse of the eight Vasus, how the eighth son Devavrata came back, and Satyavati on the banks of the Yamuna… all in this episode.

At the end: stories our elders told and small facts that Vyasa tells.

items.title: “I Will Never Marry!” – Bhishma's Vow | MB 02 | Mahabharata in English
items.description:
A crown prince gives up the throne for his father's happiness, then gives up marriage and children for life. Flowers fall from the sky: this is Bhishma. The fisher chief's one condition, Devavrata's two vows, Shantanu's boon of death only at will, Chitrangada and Vichitravirya, and Bhishma riding alone to the swayamvara at Kashi.

items.title: Born in Armour… Into the River! Kunti's Secret | MB 05 | Mahabharata in English
items.description:
One arrow, one deer, and King Pandu can never become a father. Then Kunti reveals the secret she has kept for years: a baby born with armour and earrings, set afloat on the river in a box. Sage Kindama's curse, Durvasa's mantra, the Sun god's boon, Adhiratha and Radha, and the birth of the Pandavas.

items.title: One Spark Is Enough! The Pandavas in the House of Lac | MB 08 | Mahabharata in English
items.description:

Duryodhana's plot, Purochana's 'house of good fortune', Vidura's secret warning, the escape tunnel, Bhima carrying his family through the dark forest, and Hidimba.
